sources.snippet: In summary, BiomedCLIP is a fully open-access foundation model that achieves state-of-the-art performance on various biomedical tasks, paving the way for transformative multimodal biomedical discovery and applications. We release our models at aka.ms/biomedclip to facilitate future research in multimodal biomedical AI.
